verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships its own data-capture and extraction mechanism: rosbag recording and playback via the CLI, plus a Python API for reading from and writing to bags. That lets users get recorded robot and synthetic data out programmatically. The evidence never states that the bag storage format is open or standardized, and there is no documented 'export everything and leave' path. Missing for 10: documentation that bag files use an open, standard format; a complete export of all project data (not just recorded topics); an explicit migration or exit path; independent corroboration of portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: It also provides a Python API for reading from and writing to a bag from your own source code.
it is also possible to save data generated by another source than a topic, such as synthetic data for training sets.
ROS's modularity and serialisable, recordable messages deliver a lot of value in large, multi-machine systems.
